turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
The past simple with -ed is for actions that are finished.
Look: today I jump. Yesterday I jumped.
Rule: Add -ed to a regular verb to talk about a finished action in the past.
Right: He opened the window yesterday. Wrong: He open the window yesterday.
Now you try. Write this for yesterday: "We watch a film today."
